narrative.weekly_mirror: As Sami’s teething kept you awake, you still handled the laundry, soup, and client email, even while feeling worn down. Earlier, when your mother-in-law changed Sami’s routine without asking, you wrote, "Nobody asked what I thought." The recent extension request also shows how much you were carrying at once.
narrative.tension_explanation: Across these moments, family expectations and practical demands often seem to leave little room for your own choices: your mother-in-law stepped in during Sami’s fever, Tariq had already arranged dinner, and you had to ask a client for more time while exhausted. It remains unclear how much say you feel you have in these situations, or what you want to preserve from the customs around you.
narrative.reflective_question: When you emailed the client for an extension, what did you most wish someone at home had understood about what you were carrying?
